title: One-Sided Candidate-Only Pareto Confirmation for Stochastic Simulation — Software and Research Package v1.1.0
description: Software, data, tests and replayable statistical evidence for one-sided archive-relative Pareto confirmation in stochastic simulation. The procedure may certify a positive claim or remain undecided; it is not a total fixed-confidence identification algorithm.
notes: The four-season application data are a derived public-mirror subset with machine-readable provenance. The DOI is assigned only when this new software record is published.
